about: Sainte-Catherine-de-la-Jacques-Cartier is a city west of Québec City on the Jacques-Cartier River in La Jacques-Cartier MRC—not Sainte-Catherine on Montréal’s South Shore. Duchesnay resort country, river gorges, and a growing residential community on the capital’s west side define the city. About 8,000 people live in Sainte-Catherine-de-la-Jacques-Cartier.
